master.definition_en: A thymic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of spindle and/or oval neoplastic epithelial cells. Lymphocytic infiltration is minimal or absent. It may be associated with myasthenia gravis or pure red cell aplasia. The majority of cases occur in the anterior mediastinum as Masaoka stage I tumors. Approximately 20% of the cases occur as stage II or stage III tumors. Type A thymoma generally behaves as a benign tumor and the overall survival is reported to be 100% at 5 and 10 years.
synonyms_en: primary thymic epithelial neoplasm type A
primary thymic epithelial tumor type A
primary thymic epithelial tumour type A

master.definition_en: A non-invasive malignant cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. It occurs almost exclusively in women. Small tumors are usually found incidentally. Larger tumors usually produce symptoms related to compression of the adjacent structures. It is characterized by the presence of columnar, mucin-producing epithelial cells which often form papillary projections with irregular branching and budding. There is cellular stratification, severe dysplasia, and high mitotic activity present. Complete surgical removal is usually associated with an excellent prognosis.

master.definition_en: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) is a neuromuscular disease characterized by rapidly progressive muscle weakness and wasting due to degeneration of skeletal, smooth and cardiac muscle.

curated.category: 遗传性神经肌肉与神经发育罕见病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: X连锁隐性遗传DMD基因致病突变致抗肌萎缩蛋白(Dystrophin)完全缺失，引起骨骼肌、膈肌与心肌进行性坏死纤维化；患儿多于12岁前后丧失行走能力，未经综合干预常在青春晚期死于呼吸肌或心力衰竭，经现代糖皮质激素、机械通气与心脏保护后中位生存期延至约22–30余岁。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 国内临床仍以糖皮质激素延长步行能力、无创通气及ACEI/β受体阻滞剂延缓心肌病为主，尚未有任何外显子跳跃反义寡核苷酸、HDAC抑制剂或微抗肌萎缩蛋白基因疗法正式获批纳入常规药品保障，临床极度迫切。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD未单列单基因DMD全球年死亡总数；国际多队列生存荟萃显示1990年以前出生患者中位生存约22岁，1990年后随心肺支持普及升至28–30岁以上（PMC8665435）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列官方年死亡总数；多于20–30岁间死于扩张型心肌病或呼吸衰竭

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 急性横纹肌溶解肌红蛋白尿(麻醉意外)或急性心肺失代偿救治：(1) 绝对禁用琥珀胆碱及吸入挥发性麻醉药（防致死性高钾血症及恶性高热样危象）；(2) 发生急性呼吸酸中毒予无创正压通气(BiPAP)及辅助排痰；(3) 合并糖皮质激素长期使用者在重大应激/感染时予氢化可的松应激剂量补充防止肾上腺危象。

master.definition_en: Inherited cancer-predisposing syndrome due to biallelic BRCA2 mutations is a rare cancer-predisposing syndrome, associated with the D1 subgroup of Fanconi anemia (FA), characterized by progressive bone marrow failure, cardiac, brain, intestinal or skeletal abnormalities and predisposition to various malignancies. Bone marrow suppression and the incidence of developmental abnormalities are less frequent than in other FA, but cancer risk is very high with the spectrum of childhood cancers including Wilms tumor, brain tumor (often medulloblastoma) and ALL/AML.

master.definition_en: Juvenile temporal arteritis is a rare form of vasculitis, a group of conditions that cause inflammation of the blood vessels. Unlike the classic form of temporal arteritis, this condition is generally diagnosed in late childhood or early adulthood and only affects the temporal arteries (located at the lower sides of the skull, directly underneath the temple). Affected people often have no signs or symptoms aside from a painless nodule or lump in the temporal region. The exact underlying cause of the condition is unknown. It generally occurs sporadically in people with no family history of the condition. Juvenile temporal arteritis is often treated with surgical excision and rarely recurs.

The spinal cord is typically attenuated and the limit between its end and the fatty filum is hard to distinguish. It is named transitional for its intermediate image between an isolated filum lipoma and a terminal conus region lipoma.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。
